title: Micro Commit Agent For Cursor
description: Create .cursor/agents/micro-commit.md and .agents/skills/micro-commit/SKILL.md for fast WIP micro-commits: bump counter, parent wip header, timestamp, git diff summaries. Triggers: g, go, c, commit, +1.
summary: Fixed commit message wiped before commit: removed pre-commit hook, split template-only vs full wipe, prepare-commit-msg no longer truncates COMMIT_EDITMSG, handlePrepareCommitMsg inactive only clears GK templates and preserves user/GK message text.
